Small-format assets

Actual pixel sizes. Select an icon to download it.

Download original PNG

The original raster is 1536 × 1024 px. Full lockup export is 761 × 678 px and symbol export is 703 × 551 px, including padding. All supplied assets are raster derivatives. Transparency is extracted from a flattened image. The local source matches the planning description, while the earlier chat attachment could not be compared byte for byte.

Color with purpose

Near-black surfaces, red actions, white text. The four core values come from planning. Semantic colors extend the proposal for product states.

Button contrast
Use near-black text on the vivid red button, approximately 5.0∶1 contrast. White on this red is approximately 4.0∶1, so use white for large marks and use dark text for ordinary button labels. Status text always includes a written label.

Type & layout

Roboto is the selected interface font for the phone and extension. The variable font is embedded for offline use. The logo lettering stays part of the image.
